name: Telecom

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: Steady 2Q for telcos and Indus; reduction in digital losses drive stronger 2Q for TCOM
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Private telcos' combined wireless revenue rose 3% QoQ (+9% YoY) to INR728b, with blended ARPU +2% QoQ (+4.8% YoY) and 9.6m net adds (11m in 1Q). Combined wireless EBITDA rose ~4% QoQ to INR435b (MOFSL estimate INR429b) on ~70% blended incremental margin versus ~63% in 1Q. Bharti gained ~21bp revenue share QoQ, RJio ~6bp, and Vi lost 26bp. Bharti net debt ex-lease rose INR64b QoQ to INR883b; Vi net debt rose INR34b to INR1.57t with a INR450b FY26-29 capex target and INR105b of funding tied up. TCOM consolidated EBITDA rose ~21% YoY (5% beat), margin up ~200bp to 21.3%, with digital losses halved to -3.6%; Indus was in line with a pickup in tenancy additions. Guidance: JPL 4-5% organic ARPU growth without tariff hikes, TCOM double-digit FY27 EBITDA growth, Vi public-sector-bank funding to conclude in 3Q.

unit_economics: Wireless: revenue = average paying subscribers x ARPU x months; EBITDAaL = revenue - network opex - licence fee and SUC (~8-9% of AGR) - sales and distribution - employee - lease cost; flow-through of 60-90% of incremental revenue. Towers: tenancies x rental per tenancy +/- energy margin. Enterprise: core connectivity (price down 10-15%) + digital on net revenue.

price_drivers.why: Blended ARPU rose ~2% QoQ with no round; a broad tariff hike flows through at 60-90% to EBITDA, and the street keeps pushing its assumed hike date out.

price_drivers.driver: Revenue market share and active subscriber quality
price_drivers.why: Bharti gained 21bp QoQ and Vi lost 26bp; share earned on revenue, not SIMs, drives relative multiples.

price_drivers.driver: Incremental EBITDAaL margin and capex intensity
price_drivers.why: ~70% incremental margin in 2Q lifts EBITDA; capex ex-spectrum at 14-20% of wireless revenue sets free cash flow after DoT dues.

price_drivers.driver: Government dues, spectrum instalments and Vi survival
price_drivers.why: Bharti's deferred payment liability exceeds its external net debt; Vi's spectrum payments step up to INR27,000 cr by FY29 and its funding decides market structure.

price_drivers.driver: Tower tenancy additions and counterparty health
price_drivers.why: Indus tenancy adds picked up in 2Q as Vi builds out; a Vi failure returns provisions and exits.

kpis.name: ARPU (reported and equal-days) and mix
kpis.definition: Average revenue per user per month on the company's own definition, restated to equal days, with split into tariff, mix and days.
kpis.formula: Mobile revenue / average customers / months; ARPU x 91.25 / days
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Each Rs10 of ARPU is a large share of EBITDA at 60-90% flow-through; 2Q blended ARPU +4.8% YoY was organic and the next tariff round is the largest swing factor.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'ARPU' (BHARTIARTL, IDEA, BHARTIHEXA; Jio via the Reliance deck); get_financials; MOFSL telecom tables; TRAI QPIR in the library.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA/PAT/EPS only; ARPU forecasts from broker models and the tariff-hike date from sector notes (no consensus ARPU field).
kpis.traps: ARPU definitions are not comparable (Bharti paying customers, Jio all SIMs, Vi blended); extra day in 2Q; M2M in TRAI base.

kpis.name: Revenue market share and active ex-M2M net adds
kpis.definition: Operator share of industry access AGR and active subscriber net adds with M2M removed.
kpis.formula: Operator access AGR / industry access AGR; active adds ex-M2M
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Share on revenue is the score: Bharti +21bp QoQ and Vi -26bp in 2Q; 60-75% of Bharti's 2026 TRAI net adds were machine SIMs, so raw adds mislead.
kpis.history_source: TRAI monthly and QPIR via list_library_documents / sector reports; Avendus monthly subscriber re-cut in the library; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'subscribers' / 'net adds'.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; No consensus; broker models and TRAI AGR trends.
kpis.traps: Bharti began including M2M in TRAI counts from Dec-2025; TRAI restates; AGR is not P&L revenue.

kpis.name: EBITDAaL margin and incremental margin
kpis.definition: EBITDA after lease costs over revenue, with incremental margin on quarterly revenue change.
kpis.formula: (EBITDA - lease depreciation - lease interest) / revenue; delta EBITDA / delta revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: ~70% blended incremental margin beat MOFSL's 55% estimate and lifted wireless EBITDA to INR435b; EBITDAaL is the cross-company basis because tower rent sits below EBITDA under Ind AS 116.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (D&A and finance cost split, lease note); get_investor_presentation metric filter 'EBITDAaL' / 'EBITDA margin'; MOFSL telecom tables.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg EBITDA / Sales (reported EBITDA, not EBITDAaL); EBITDAaL forecasts from broker models.
kpis.traps: India ex-passive EBITDAaL is call-only at Bharti; Indus consolidation (19-Nov-2024) distorts Dec-2024; Jio fibre sits in an InvIT.

kpis.name: Capex intensity and equity FCF after DoT payments
kpis.definition: Capex excluding spectrum as % of revenue and cash flow after leases, interest and spectrum/AGR instalments.
kpis.formula: Capex / revenue; OCF - capex - lease - interest - DPL instalments
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Bharti 2Q FCF fell to INR97b on deferred 5G spectrum repayments (+INR44b YoY) and a data-centre land purchase; JPL cash capex fell 49% in 1H giving INR189b FCF; dividends are paid from this number.
kpis.history_source: get_financials cash flow; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'capex' / 'free cash flow'; transcripts.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Bloomberg capex not a listed field; capex guidance in transcripts (Vi INR450b FY26-29).
kpis.traps: Capex scope (with or without Indus) changes the ratio; spectrum cash shown separately; Jio capex capitalisation.

kpis.name: Three-layer net debt and DPL schedule
kpis.definition: External net debt, plus deferred spectrum and AGR payment liability, plus lease liabilities, each over matching EBITDA.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Bharti's net debt ex-lease was INR883b but DPL is larger than that; Vi's INR1.57t and AGR reassessment (Rs64,046 cr) set equity-need risk and dilution.
kpis.history_source: get_financials balance sheet (borrowings, lease liabilities); annual reports for DPL tranches via read_library_document.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Management and broker projections.
kpis.traps: Management quotes external debt only; AGR relief is upside not base case; Africa local-currency debt.

kpis.name: Tenancies, sharing factor and rental per tenancy [towers]
kpis.definition: Co-locations, gross adds and exits, sharing factor and rental per tenancy, with provisions separated.
kpis.formula: Tenancies / towers; rental revenue / average tenancies
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Tower returns rise from 12% to 39% for 1 to 3 tenants; Indus 2Q tenancy adds picked up and Africa rollouts (Uganda, Zambia, Nigeria 3QFY27) add growth.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA only; tenancy guidance in transcripts.
kpis.traps: Provision write-backs inflated FY25 margin (~69% vs ~52% ex-provisions); energy pass-through at negative margin.

kpis.name: Homes broadband net adds, ARPU and capex per connect
kpis.definition: Home broadband customers, FTTH versus FWA mix, ARPU and capex per net add.
kpis.formula: Net adds; homes revenue / customers; capex / net adds
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Homes OpFCF was about -INR776 cr in Q1FY27; low-price FWA acquisition churned and dilutes ARPU, so payback decides whether the adjacency earns its cost.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'homes' / 'FWA' (BHARTIARTL); get_financials segment note.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Management commentary in transcripts.
kpis.traps: Jio counts home broadband inside ARPU; FWA equipment cost.

kpis.name: Africa constant-currency growth and FX gap
kpis.definition: Airtel Africa revenue and EBITDA in constant currency versus reported, with mobile money.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Bharti's consolidated revenue and EBITDA rose 4-5% QoQ on strong Africa; the naira and other currency moves create gaps of several points between CC and reported.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Management commentary; broker FX assumptions.
kpis.traps: CC base resets each April; hyperinflation accounting (Malawi).

kpis.name: Enterprise data revenue, core vs digital margin [enterprise]
kpis.definition: Data revenue growth reported and constant currency, with digital portfolio margin and core connectivity margin.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: TCOM data revenue grew ~12% YoY (~6% ex-FX) and digital losses halved to -3.6%, taking EBITDA margin to 21.3%; digital margin path decides the multiple.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'data revenue' / 'digital portfolio' (TATACOMM); get_financials.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA for TATACOMM; company guidance of double-digit FY27 EBITDA growth.
kpis.traps: FX can add 6-8pp to INR growth; net vs gross revenue; acquisitions.

macro_inputs.source: Broker sector notes and sector reports in the library

macro_inputs.why: Tower energy margin and network opex

valuation_anchor: SOTP on forward EV/EBITDAaL (India ex-passive core multiple from own post-Nov-2024 regime band, street 11.5-15x; Africa, Indus and Nxtra at market value less 20-25% holdco discount), net debt layers matched to EBITDA basis without double-counting DoT dues; Vi on scenario EV/cash EBITDA; towers on EV/EBITDA ex-provisions.
watch_next_quarter: Per MOFSL, watch Bharti Hexacom subscriber normalisation in 3Q after weather disruption, completion of Vi's public-sector-bank funding in 3Q and its tower rollout, Indus order book and Nigeria rollout in 3QFY27, TCOM's double-digit FY27 EBITDA growth, and any tariff round given JPL's 4-5% organic ARPU claim.
